motion: Does consciousness fundamentally pervade reality and point toward God?

moves.currentDescription: Beauty, truth, and goodness preexist human invention, as shown by beautiful forms that arose before human observers.
moves.lockedProposition: Beauty, truth, and goodness preexist human invention, as shown by beautiful forms that arose before human observers.
moves.completeLockedSourceExcerpt: For example, I don't think that truth, beauty, and goodness are things we invent and paint on the walls of our prison cell in order to cheer ourselves up. It's quite true, although exaggerated, that in different cultures at different times people find different things beautiful, for example, or have different slightly different moralities. This is true, but very largely they are overlapping. But that's really not the point. The point is, where does beauty come from in the first place? This is a question Darwin asked repeatedly. Yes, given beauty, it can be used for mate selection. But where is beauty from? Why is something considered beautiful? What is it? And I think it's a very astute question. And I think these things preexist us. I think they are part of the way the cosmos is, even before we were around. There were very beautiful creatures.

moves.currentDescription: Showing how systems acquire novel properties from their material constitution remains productive and need not be impossible for consciousness.
moves.lockedProposition: Showing how systems acquire novel properties from their material constitution remains productive and need not be impossible for consciousness.
moves.completeLockedSourceExcerpt: if if I if I felt there was greater understanding to be had and explanatory power to be had from that perspective, I'd I would I would adapt. But I think from from and maybe this is just a historical fact about my own trajectory trying to bite that bullet and show how a system can come to have properties it didn't previously have in virtue of its material constitution I find productive and and useful. I don't know if it will get us all the way there. Consciousness is particularly tricky because it travels not away from subjectivity, but back towards it. But I don't think it's an I don't think it's an impossible task.
